origin: Locally authored drawing via LibreDWG 0.14 dwgadd and dwgwrite JSON; no fixture committed. The JSON roundtrip angle was restored to the original exact half-pi so that the baseline meets the existing MLINESTYLE source profile.
checks: The source observer checks exact bit spans, handle roles, bounded ASCII strings and integers, bound unchanged APPID and source codepage.
Existing staged table identities, dictionary graph, exact generated-root output and standard-object readback are required before strict publication.
Both ASCII and binary outputs were read independently with ezdxf 1.4.5 and contained the same APPID and EED values.
ASan adapter controls mutate source EED values, APPID, raw frame, and late raw frame; they verify destination preservation and corrected retry, as well as cross-version refusal.
The generated fast test recreates the control when LibreDWG 0.14 tools are available.
limits: This is a narrow local R14-to-R14 source and output profile, not general dictionary EED, R13, UTF-8 output, native cloning semantics, or a promoted format support claim.
Independent native duplicate and clone semantics remain unresolved; producer and consumer evidence is not equivalent to AutoCAD semantic qualification.
